reviews.title: Over $500 charged for a subscription I never authorized — refund refused
reviews.text:
This app charged me over $500 for a monthly subscription I never knowingly signed up for. As soon as I noticed the first charge, I immediately attempted to cancel — only to find out that the subscription can’t be canceled through the App Store like any normal app. Instead, it requires cancellation directly through the app itself, which is completely illogical and, frankly, abusive.

Despite canceling as soon as I became aware of the issue, I kept getting charged $39 every month. I never used the premium features, and yet the company refuses to refund the full amount. This is deceptive, non-transparent, and unethical behavior. Stay away from this app — it’s a predatory business model disguised as a subscription service.
